_comment: Warrior NPC class, hand-written from ./outline. Same shape as Data/Classes/Classes.json plus the NPC fields documented in Generators/NpcGenerator/README.md. Descriptions are statblock prose; [MON] becomes 'the warrior' and {level} the NPC's level.
name: Warrior

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Proficiency in one saving throw (Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution), two skills, all armor, shields, and all simple and martial weapons.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: As a bonus action, the [MON] regains 1d10 + {level} hit points.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: The [MON]'s attack rolls score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: The [MON] can attack twice (three times from 15th level) whenever it takes the Attack action on its turn.

features.name: Battle Readiness
features.description: The [MON] has advantage on initiative rolls.

features.name: Indomitable
features.description: The [MON] can reroll a saving throw that it fails, but it must use the new roll.
